description: How many of the tracked places list a given app domain (a link to it, or a page of its own), from the site's nightly read of every place. For the known big apps (candy.ai and the like) also which places, with the page where it was seen; for any other domain the count, and the full answer on the site's check (one free check a month with an account, more with credits).
name: where_is_app_listed
title: Where an app is already listed
